meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 啰嗦的回复压成简短回答，省下输出开销还保住技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 回答总是长篇大论，你只想看要点。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI replies into short answers while keeping the technical points intact.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI answers ramble on and you just want the key points.

howto.what: Claude 回话变极简压缩风格：去掉冠词、填充词和客套话，技术细节、代码、错误原文照旧保留。默认 full 档，整场会话一直生效，直到你说 stop caveman 或 normal mode。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman，或提到 “caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”、“be brief” 等说法时触发。

say.note: 切到 lite 档，保留冠词和完整句子

howto.what_en: Claude replies in terse, compressed style: drops articles, filler and pleasantries, keeps technical substance, code and exact error text. Default level is full, and it stays on for the whole session until you say stop caveman or normal mode.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman, or when you say "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" and similar phrases.

say_en.note: Switches to lite level, keeps full sentences
Switches to classical Chinese terse level
